metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Matthew Schultz

plugins.name: cmux
plugins.description: Claude Code integration for the cmux terminal multiplexer — workspace management, pane splitting, notifications, sidebar status, browser automation, and multi-agent orchestration

plugins.name: mjsfx-sound-design
plugins.description: Design retro / 8-bit game sound effects (and invent original ones) with the MJSFX app through its MCP tools — coins, lasers, explosions, jumps, power-ups, UI blips, cohesive sound families, and experimental textures

plugins.name: swift-midi
plugins.description: Verified knowledge of orchetect's swift-midi package family (the successor to MIDIKit) for writing MIDI code in Swift apps — device I/O, virtual endpoints, CC/note/transport events, MIDI learn, clock sync, network/Bluetooth MIDI, and sandbox entitlements
